decisions.reason: It fits closely with the firm's compliance-oriented expansion, appears to have enough strategic relevance to stay above aspiration absent contrary evidence, and any uncertainty is likely covered by organisational slack.

As a homepage-promoted flagship that builds directly on the core hosting business and stated future direction, management would be unlikely to drop it unless results clearly fell far below aspiration.

This offer is near the established hosting business and likely useful for serving existing customer needs, but as a less prominently signalled extension it has a somewhat higher drop risk if uptake disappoints.
